scope: iOS 14.0 beta 5 18A5351d original research kernel and n104ap device tree; no Apple implementation bytes retained here

decoded_kernel.origin: Unencrypted original research kernel IM4P payload, LZFSE decoded for read-only inspection

device_tree.inspection: Unencrypted bvx2 payload decoded in memory with previously verified local liblzfse; 218980 decoded bytes; little-endian Apple device tree properties parsed read-only

wiring.interpretation: Source connects MT IRQ to original AOP GPIO pin34. MT queue insertion asserts active-low IRQ. GPIO implements low-level and falling-edge modes. Original function-set_int_config targets the same controller/pin; no source evidence justifies reversing polarity.

gpio_cfg_decode.input_level: For GPIO function, read bit0 reflects input pin; queued MT IRQ is low.

register_read_limits.avoid: Do not bulk-read through SPI1 RXDATA at 0x235104020: reading it pops RX FIFO and may run transfer logic. Only individually reviewed addresses above are observational.
register_read_limits.execution: Addresses derived and source reviewed; this inspection did not connect to the live guest or perform register reads.

handleStart.meaning: Creation of the named driver/workloop is insufficient evidence that a HID client opened or powered the chip.

handleOpen.checks: 0xfffffff00855ceec/cef0: client and callback nonnull; cef4/cef8: no existing callback; cf24: superclass open succeeded

enableInterrupt.branch: Saved interrupt type at this+0x198 compared with 1 at 0xfffffff00855d248
enableInterrupt.type_1: Sets this+0x196=1 at 0xfffffff00855d26c and calls IOInterruptEventSource::interruptOccurred through slot0xf8; original diagnostic states delayed enabling.
enableInterrupt.delayed_completion: interruptAction clears this+0x196 at 0xfffffff008561598 and calls event-source enable at 0xfffffff0085615cc; this is not a permanent disable.

bootChip.power: setChipPower(true) at 0xfffffff00856003c when this+0x118 is false; failure checked at 0xfffffff008560040
bootChip.bootloader: Subsequently marks boot flags and queries original getBootloader before bootloader work.

original_driver.resolution_method: llvm-objdump-18 original symbolized code; virtual targets resolved from original vtable chained-pointer low32 offsets relative to 0xfffffff007004000. No instructions modified.

configureSPI_initial_zero_transfer.sequence: After successful AppleARMSPIDevice::setSPIConfig, tests cached configuration flag this+0x250 and selected byte. If unset/changed, stores a zero uint32 at stack+0x4c (0xfffffff008560774), then calls AppleARMSPIDevice::transferData(buffer,4,NULL,0,NULL,0) at 0xfffffff0085607c4.
configureSPI_initial_zero_transfer.provider_vtable: Original __ZTV17AppleARMSPIDevice at 0xfffffff00778ab78, address point +16, slot0x578 resolves transferData; slots0x548/550 resolve getSPIConfig/setSPIConfig.
configureSPI_initial_zero_transfer.power_off_caller: powerOff(true) clears this+0x250 at 0xfffffff00855f160 and invokes configureSPI(1) at 0xfffffff00855f210. handleStart invokes powerOff(true).
configureSPI_initial_zero_transfer.inference_limit: A single emulated HBPP type0 during startup may be this normal four-zero-byte configuration transfer; it does not establish bootChip or firmware loading began. The current observation is not a proven protocol behavior bug.

actual_execution_context.finding: Parent-controlled VNC tap produced host callback and make/touch/break/out-of-range enqueues, with no dequeue/control/tx-drained event in the observed window. Parent reported same boundary for QMP tap.
limits: No completed packet-level delivery observed does not prove zero SPI bytes: a partial transaction can avoid trace boundaries.
A TX drain proves guest bus clocking, not OS or UIKit acceptance.
Missing touch response alone does not identify polarity, firmware, client matching, or power as the failure.
MT emulator has no explicit firmware-ready Boolean or existing QOM property exposing private RX/TX/queue state.
Next boot startup traces plus individually reviewed register reads should separate never-started initialization from an incomplete boot/firmware handshake.

mutations: None to guest, firmware, or emulator behavior; evidence document only.

post_setup_register_observation.decode: GPIO group6 selected, INPUT_ENABLE set, GPIO function, CFG_DISABLE, inputlevel0. SPI RUN clear, modeled transfer MODE invalid, counts zero. CFG bits3/4/14 are unmodeled by current source.
post_setup_register_observation.trace: Six trace events enabled before cont; parent reports exactly one type0 first-byte event through180s and unchanged registers after rendered setup. Extended command-boundary trace is required to establish completion/pending response.
post_setup_register_observation.provenance_limit: Values and complete-window count reported by parent; consult raw run transcript for execution evidence.
